overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn appeared on Medford Happenings to discuss city accomplishments, communication strategies, and major ongoing projects including zoning reform and the new high school proposal.

items.title: Personal Background and Leadership Philosophy
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn shared details regarding her family, her history in Medford, and her commitment to ethical decision-making and accountability.

items.title: Municipal Accomplishments
items.summary: The Mayor highlighted improvements in professional hiring practices, significant park renovations, the growth of the housing pipeline, and various fire station upgrades.

items.title: Current Challenges Facing the City
items.summary: Discussion centered on managing resident affordability for the 42% low-income population, ongoing litigation, and the complexities of personnel management.

items.title: Public Communication and Engagement
items.summary: The administration is utilizing monthly newsletters, robocalls, and a new neighborhood liaison committee to improve information sharing and resident feedback.

items.title: Zoning Reform and Housing Strategy
items.summary: The Mayor explained the decision to slow the rezoning process to ensure transparency and to balance the need for more housing with business district parking requirements.

items.title: Medford High School Infrastructure Project
items.summary: The Mayor addressed the urgent need for a new high school due to failing building systems and the importance of creating a fiscally responsible plan to pass a future debt exclusion vote.

items.title: Future Vision and 2050 Outlook
items.summary: The long-term vision includes redeveloping vacant Medford Square lots into mixed-use spaces with affordable housing and a grocery store, alongside modernized city services.
